name: AWR Instance Efficiency 分析诊断
description: AWR Instance Efficiency 指标反映数据库整体运行效率，包括 Buffer Hit Ratio、Library Cache Hit Ratio、Soft Parse Ratio、In-Memory Sort Ratio、Redo NoWait Ratio 等。需结合负载量解读，高效率指标不等于无性能问题。

skip_when.desc: 全表扫描为主的 OLAP 负载（Buffer Hit 低是正常的）

root_causes.name: Buffer Cache Hit Ratio 低
root_causes.desc: 大量物理读。可能 SGA 不足或全表扫描过多。OLTP < 95% 需关注，OLAP 不适用此指标。

root_causes.name: Library Cache Hit Ratio 低
root_causes.desc: 硬解析过多，Shared Pool 不足或未使用绑定变量。

root_causes.name: Soft Parse Ratio 低
root_causes.desc: 大量硬解析。< 95% 需关注。

root_causes.name: In-Memory Sort Ratio 低
root_causes.desc: 排序溢出到磁盘。sort_area_size 或 PGA_AGGREGATE_TARGET 不足。

root_causes.name: Redo NoWait Ratio 低
root_causes.desc: redo log 写入等待，log buffer 或 redo log 切换过频。

olap.desc: Buffer Hit 不适用，关注 Sort Ratio

step1_efficiency_metrics.desc: 从 AWR 获取效率指标
step1_efficiency_metrics.sql: SELECT metric_name, ROUND(AVG(value), 2) avg_value, ROUND(MIN(value), 2) min_value FROM dba_hist_sysmetric_summary s JOIN dba_hist_snapshot sn ON s.snap_id = sn.snap_id WHERE metric_name IN ('Buffer Cache Hit Ratio', 'Library Cache Hit Ratio', 'Soft Parse Ratio', 'Memory Sorts Ratio', 'Redo NoWait Ratio') AND sn.begin_interval_time > SYSDATE - 1 GROUP BY metric_name

step2_buffer_cache_advice.sql: SELECT size_for_estimate, ROUND(estd_physical_read_factor, 2) read_factor, estd_physical_reads FROM v$db_cache_advice WHERE name = 'DEFAULT' ORDER BY size_for_estimate

step3_parse_stats.sql: SELECT name, value FROM v$sysstat WHERE name IN ('parse count (total)', 'parse count (hard)', 'parse count (failures)', 'execute count')

step4_sort_stats.sql: SELECT name, value FROM v$sysstat WHERE name IN ('sorts (memory)', 'sorts (disk)', 'sorts (rows)')
